rationale_one_line: Matt Pocock's skills are an observability layer over agent behavior (diagnose, triage, grill-with-docs, git-guardrails), so the cctv preset reframes as engineer-ops, not surveillance; SCHEMATIC honors the loop structure (intent, inner loop, codebase audit) the 17 skills compose into; cctv is the only preset not used in the last 14 entries.
writing_tone_notes: Engineer-to-engineer. Direct, pragmatic, no marketing. Contractions where natural. The numbers earn the claim. Lead with the diagram (the skills compose). Land on a stake about feedback loops, not on stars.
do_rules: Make the SCHEMATIC diagram the hero. 4 nodes, named after real skills. The composition IS the argument.
Name two specific skills in copy (diagnose, grill-with-docs) so the reader has concrete handles.
Honor the install ritual. The npx one-liner is the proof of frictionless adoption.
Close on the loop, not the count. The framework ends with the position, not the metric.
dont_rules: No version numbers in any copy surface.
No exclamation points, no superlatives, no 'first ever' claims.
No phrase overlap between tweet, why-this-one, and scene copy.
No exhaustive skill grocery list. Pick the two or three that carry the loop.
No surveillance/spy framing. The cctv preset reads as ops-center, not panopticon.
